title: Tessera global RGB visualization mosaic
description:
A true-colour RGBA visualization mosaic derived from the Tessera geospatial embeddings (geoemb convention), global, EPSG:4326, 0.0001 deg (~10 m). Zarr V3, zarr-conventions multiscales v0.1, 10 levels (path "0" finest 1,800,000 x 3,600,000 .. "9" coarsest 3,000 x 7,827 -- actually shape[0] x shape[1]; see cube:dimensions), blosc/zstd with bitshuffle. Each level group holds an array `rgb` with shape [lat, lon, band(4)] uint8 (RGBA) plus a 4-element `band` coordinate -- **the band axis is last**, not leading as in most of the other fixtures in this catalog; a reader that assumes band-first will misread the array. The store is sparse near the poles (requests there 404; coverage follows the Tessera embeddings footprint, not a filled global grid).

License for this GeoTessera-derived product is not published on the source.coop listing at the time of writing; declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: draws (RGBA, no render block needed -- the asset is already 3/4-band uint8 colour).

band.description: RGBA, trailing axis: array shape is [lat, lon, band], not [band, lat, lon].

rgb.description: Level 0 (finest); shape [1800000, 3600000, 4]. Band is the LAST axis.
